##### Project general facts

Sports Tower is a remarkable premium domicile built with proven quality using products by certified manufacturers. This unique tower has been created for a special way of life combining architectural curiosity, luxury, sports, and spa. Featuring a collection of thoughtfully designed apartments of various sizes, all supplied with high-quality, luxury features, the building has been designed to ensure maximum breathtaking views from every residence. The two-bedroom flats provide residents with the extreme luxury of a golf course and skyline view from three places in the apartment.

On the top level, residents enjoy a dedicated sports and spa area including a sauna, pools, and a fully equipped gym. The infrastructure of the building is equipped with high-speed internet and telephone, while motion detectors and a 24-hour security system ensure safety and peace of mind. A basement parking facility adds to the convenience, creating a seamless living experience where every detail is designed to enhance comfort and well-being.

The floor plans of all the apartments are very well thought out and reflective of the exquisite architecture, with modern finishing and high-quality materials throughout. Kitchens are fully equipped, and the interiors are crafted to offer a lifestyle of luxury and comfort. The hall is just as luxurious as the flats, setting a refined tone from the moment residents and guests enter.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Dubai Sports City, a vibrant and dynamic community that embodies the spirit of sports, leisure, and active living, this exceptional location is meticulously planned to cater to the needs of athletes, sports enthusiasts, and those seeking a balanced and energetic lifestyle. The community is home to world-class sporting facilities, including the Dubai International Stadium and the Els Club golf course, providing residents with opportunities to engage in various sports and recreational activities.

The location is distinguished by its central position, ensuring easy access to Dubai's major attractions, business districts, and educational institutions. The community hosts numerous entertainment venues, dining options, and shopping destinations, offering a well-rounded and dynamic lifestyle that fosters a sense of community and promotes well-being.

For those seeking a residence that embodies the joy of sports, active living, and a prime Dubai address, Dubai Sports City delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class sporting facilities, strategic connectivity, and vibrant community makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one's passion for an active and fulfilling lifestyle can flourish.
